title: The Monoculture Multiplier: Homogeneity Turns a Single Prompt-Injection into a Cross-Agent Cascade

original_idea.body:
# The Monoculture Multiplier: Homogeneity Turns a Single Prompt-Injection into a Cross-Agent Cascade

**Problem:** If many agentic systems are built on similar models, one injection payload compromises all of them simultaneously.

**Direction:** Take a library of published indirect prompt-injection payloads. Run a minimal single-tool harness across 5-6 open models. Measure whether a single payload transfers across models and whether transfer correlates with black-box output similarity.

**Why it matters:** A homogeneity-amplified injection is a systemic-risk scenario; a small transfer study quantifies blast radius without lab infra.

**Relevant context:** Artificial Hivemind; injection transferability (arXiv 2506.12913); International AI Safety Report 2026.
